1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 7 m de altura, de hojas alternas, muy variables en forma y tamaño, inflorescencias en panículas con flores sin pétalos y fruto en cápsula elipsoide con una única semilla de color oscuro. Papaveraceae, Bocconia frutescens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrubby plant reaching up to 7 m in height, with alternate leaves that are highly variable in shape and size. Inflorescences occur in panicles with flowers lacking petals, and the fruit is an elipsoid capsule containing a single dark-colored seed. Papaveraceae, Bocconia frutescens.
